name: app-6abc1d97a7b48191be7288939d934962
description: Live LPP city bus arrivals, trip planning, stop search and nearest stops for Ljubljana, Slovenia.

interface.longDescription:
ljbus brings live arrival times for LPP, the city bus network of Ljubljana (Slovenia), into ChatGPT. Ask "when is the next 6 at Bavarski dvor?" and ChatGPT finds the stop, picks the right direction and reads live GPS-based predictions — the same data as ljbus.cc.

- Search stops by name or stop code, with direction and the lines that serve them
- Find the stops nearest to a location, with distance
- Get live arrivals at a stop, grouped by line and destination, optionally for one line
- Plan a bus trip from A to B (stops, addresses or places), with transfers and walking

Every result links to the stop's full live board and timetable on ljbus.cc. Read-only, no account needed. Works in English and Slovenian.

Limitations: covers LPP city buses in Ljubljana only — not intercity buses or trains. ljbus is unofficial and not affiliated with LPP; arrival times are predictions.
defaultPrompt: When is the next bus 6 at Bavarski dvor towards Dolgi most?
Kdaj pride naslednja dvojka na Novih Jaršah proti centru?
What's arriving at the Pošta stop in Ljubljana right now?

positive.description: Next bus of one line at a named stop, in a given direction
positive.prompt: When is the next bus 6 at Bavarski dvor towards Dolgi most?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Bavarski dvor (stop code 600012, towards_centre), then returns the next line 6 arrivals to DOLGI MOST P+R in minutes with live/scheduled status and the stop's ljbus.cc link.

positive.description: Question in Slovenian, direction towards the centre
positive.prompt: Kdaj pride naslednja dvojka na Novih Jaršah proti centru?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers in Slovenian with the next line 2 arrivals at a Nove Jarše stop in the towards_centre direction (e.g. 203161 or 203171), in minutes.

positive.description: Nearest stops to a location and what is arriving there
positive.prompt: I'm at 46.0569, 14.5058 in Ljubljana. Which bus stops are closest and what's arriving in the next 10 minutes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the nearest stops (Bavarski dvor about 50 m away in both directions, then others within a few hundred metres) and the arrivals due there in the next 10 minutes.

positive.description: All arrivals at a stop given by its code
positive.prompt: Show me all upcoming arrivals at LPP stop 600011.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live arrivals for all lines at Bavarski dvor (600011, away_from_centre), grouped by line and destination.

positive.description: Trip planning between two named places
positive.prompt: How do I get from Nove Jarše to Vič by bus right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a Nove Jarše and a Vič stop, then returns bus options (e.g. line 7 to Razstavišče and a change to line 6 towards Dolgi most) with walks, lines, stops, scheduled times and the ljbus.cc planner link.

negative.description: Trains are not covered (Slovenian Railways, not LPP buses)
negative.prompt: When is the next train from Ljubljana to Maribor?

negative.description: Intercity buses are not covered (Arriva/Nomago, not LPP city buses)
negative.prompt: What time does the bus from Ljubljana to Koper leave today?
When is the next bus 6 at Piccadilly Circus in London?

review.commerce_description: ljbus does not sell products or process payments; it only returns public transit information.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: listing now covers all four tools, including trip planning (plan_trip). Every tool is read-only with explicit annotations: readOnlyHint true, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint true, openWorldHint false (bounded LPP network catalog; no writes, no arbitrary destinations).

sl-SI.subtitle: Prihodi avtobusov LPP v živo
sl-SI.description:
ljbus v ChatGPT prinese prihode avtobusov LPP v Ljubljani v živo. Vprašajte "kdaj pride naslednja šestica na Bavarskem dvoru?" in ChatGPT poišče postajo, izbere pravo smer ter prebere napovedi prihodov na podlagi GPS — iste podatke kot na ljbus.cc.

- iskanje postaj po imenu ali kodi, s smerjo in linijami
- najbližje postaje glede na lokacijo
- prihodi v živo na postaji, po linijah in smereh
- načrtovanje poti od A do B s prestopi

Brez računa, samo branje podatkov. Samo mestni avtobusi LPP v Ljubljani. ljbus je neuraden in ni povezan z LPP.
